:::{#exm-var-diff-logodds}

#### Variance of an estimated difference in beetle log-odds

For the `beetles` [logistic regression model](#def-logistic-regression) (`beetles_glm_ungrouped`),
let $\vx = (1, 1.8)\'$ and $\vxs = (1, 1.7)\'$,
so that $\diffvx = (0, 0.1)\'$.
The code below applies @thm-var-diff-logodds,
using the estimated covariance matrix of the coefficients in place of $\Sigma$:

```{r}
#| label: exm-var-diff-logodds-calc
#| code-fold: show
ex_dx <- c(0, 1.8 - 1.7)
ex_sigma <- vcov(beetles_glm_ungrouped)
ex_var_quadratic <- drop(t(ex_dx) %*% ex_sigma %*% ex_dx)
ex_var_slope <- 0.1^2 * ex_sigma["dose", "dose"]
```

The quadratic form gives `r round(ex_var_quadratic, 6)`.
Because $\diffvx$ has a zero in the intercept position,
the variance should equal $0.1^2$ times the estimated variance of the dose coefficient,
which is `r round(ex_var_slope, 6)`.

:::
